rules.rule: High energy visual language: vibrant gradients (orange-red, electric blue, neon green), bold typography, full-bleed workout imagery. Vibrant mood is default for fitness.
Workout cards: background image with gradient overlay for contrast, workout name in 20sp bold white, duration and difficulty below, large Play/Start button bottom-right.
Progress is the hero metric: weekly ring chart, streak counter with fire icon, personal records displayed as large numbers. These must be above the fold on home.
Active workout screen: large countdown timer center screen, exercise name 24sp, next exercise preview below, minimal UI so user can focus. Dark background always.
Activity feed showing friend workouts with kudos/like mechanic. Leaderboard view with rank, avatar, stat. Competition and community features drive retention.
